newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down before 1997/98 budget.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down before 1997/98 budget.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Thursday amid squaring of positions ahead of 1997/98 (July-June) budget due on Friday, dealers said.

They said cautious investors squared out of the market to avoid any negative reaction to the Friday budget. "The market was overbought amid heavy buying by enthusiastic retail investors earlier in the week," dealer Shakeel Anwar said.

The Karachi 100-share index fell 7.77 points, or 0.49 percent, to close at 1,577.39 at 0915 GMT. Losers beat gainers 208 to 50. Pakistan State Oil fell 3.0 rupees to 324 rupees and Engro Chemicals 1.75 to 139.
